title: Calendar Day, Week and Timeline views replace the Coming soon line

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-10-26 stream K (SCAN-1134), calendar redesign plan phases 7 and 8

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-26. THE CONSEQUENCE: a Space team could look at its calendar as a month, an agenda or a board, but never as one day, one week with hours, or nine weeks of Plans, so planning a busy Thursday or seeing what a Plan holds across a season meant paging the month grid and guessing. The view bar said "Day, Week, Timeline Coming soon". THE FIX: three views in a box beside Month, Agenda, Board. Day and Week are a 7 AM to 11 PM time grid at 52px an hour with overlaps packed into lanes, an all-day row for whole-day runs and to-dos, the viewer's now line in the Space's zone, and a Week column header that opens that day. Timeline is nine weeks from last Monday, one row per Plan with its dates as pills, a span bar and to-do dots (overdue in the event colour), a today line, and a row for loose to-dos. Every chip is calendarPresentation (form, colour and word, the word always printed on this team surface). Items read the same CalendarEvent list the grid, Agenda and Board read, so nothing is a second source; CalendarEvent gains endTimeLabel so a block has a length (an item with no end holds an hour). A block opens its Plan, or its row in the List; an item with neither is text, not a dead button. The choice rides ?look= and its own cookie (freq-cal-look-<slug>) so the pinned ?view= values and the surface cookie are untouched. NOT BUILT HERE: drag to move on the time grid (the month grid and console carry that with Undo and the series dialog), and real two-way sync (plan phase 12, waits for the owner). See ADR-1876.

verify.note: Fails on main (no time-view module, the bar says Coming soon), passes with this change.
